card.name: Linking words in either-or pairs
card.fires_on: The small word that joins a pair of opposites or alternatives, such as 'or' in 'good or ill', 'to' in 'Atlantic to the Pacific', or 'be' in 'be it a chair'. It is common after 'whether', 'alike', or 'be it'.

modes.label: 'or' joining opposites
modes.description: The word 'or' links two contrasting items, often before 'alike' or after 'whether'.

modes.description: The word 'to' links two extremes of a range.
